name: Hide DNS requests
description: The adversary is trying to hide his DNS-requests from third parties, which prevent them from knowing which sites were requested.

subtechniques.name: Masking DNS
subtechniques.description: Masking DNS traffic to prevent where the request came from reduces the attack surface and success of correlation attacks.

subtechniques.name: Oblivious DNS over HTTPS (ODoH)
subtechniques.description: Oblivious DoH (ODoH) makes secure DNS over HTTPS (DoH) queries into private queries which prevent the leakage of client IP addresses to resolvers.

subtechniques.name: Third-party DNS servers
subtechniques.description: Third party DNS-servers might be leveraged to hide the origin of DNS-requests.

procedures.name: FreeDNS
procedures.description: FreeDNS offers free and premium DNS services for subdomains and domains, with dynamic updates, IPv6 support, web forwarding and more. https://freedns.afraid.org/

procedures.name: Nextdns.io
procedures.description: NextDNS blocks ads and trackers on websites and in apps and provides a safe and supervised internet for kids - on all devices and on all networks. https://nextdns.io/

procedures.name: DNS over HTTPS (DoH)
procedures.description: Encrypts DNS queries within HTTPS traffic to prevent ISP-level DNS interception and logging

procedures.name: DNS over TLS (DoT)
procedures.description: Encrypts DNS queries over a dedicated TLS connection to prevent interception and logging by network intermediaries

procedures.name: NortonDNS
procedures.description: Public DNS service with content filtering; used as an alternative resolver to reduce ISP-level DNS logging

procedures.name: OpenDNS
procedures.description: Cisco-owned public DNS service with content filtering capabilities. https://www.opendns.com/

procedures.name: ComodoDNS
procedures.description: Comodo Secure DNS is a domain name resolution service that resolves your secure DNS requests through a worldwide network of redundant DNS security servers. https://www.comodo.com/secure-dns/
